name: @amykit/plugin-terminal
description: Drives an interactive terminal program through terminal-use: run it, type, press keys, wait for text and read the screen.
author: Nicolas Melo

amy.about: Use it when a proof has to drive an interactive terminal program, such as an editor or a CLI that prompts. It adds terminal operations a prove scenario can call: run a program, type, press keys, wait for text and read the screen. It needs the terminal-use CLI on the machine.
